title: AI Toolkit: Libraries and Essays for Exploring the Technology and Ethics of AI

bias_targets.methodology: Demonstrated through educational computational notebooks that examine intersectional accuracy disparities in facial recognition datasets and analyze word embeddings for implicit associations between particular careers and specific genders.

Demonstrated through educational computational notebooks that examine class imbalances and accuracy disparities in facial recognition software, as well as comparing the typical skin tones of AI-generated images across different prompts (e.g., 'lawyer' vs. 'criminal').
